scope: Exploratory extension, separate from primary complete-grid claim
full_endpoint: load, choose independently random observed training subset, center observed targets, fit, all 512 off-grid posterior means and latent variances, metric computation, prediction output, including process startup and imports
mask: sorted choice without replacement, keep round(N*(1-fraction)), RNG seed 20000+dataset_seed; mask independent of targets and test data

cg.preconditioner: observed restriction of exact full-grid inverse

baseline: blocked exact observed covariance construction in Fortran storage, LAPACK Cholesky, batched triangular prediction variance solve; no explicit inverse
quality: same frozen primary tolerances from research/preregister.json, not relaxed
resource_cutoff: If the entire full-case plan cannot finish by experiment minute 75, stop between methods/cases, preserve unfinished/timeout records and report the incomplete plan; never silently omit failed cases.
mean_only: if studied, label as a different endpoint, not evidence for the full mean+variance result
